model: Massless tree hard scattering coupled to collinear incoming PDFs/h1 and one standard-axis fragmentation TMD, with canonical Collins-11 matching and Q=mu=pT. This is a declared reconstruction, not recovered STAR17 author code or finite-R/NLO siTMDFJF matching.

standard_TMD_in_jets.equations: 9-12,58-60,64-69,71-72,77-78 and paragraph following69; Collins-11 constants absent

STAR17.equations: 1-6,13-19; historical pT scale prescription and phenomenological scope

conventions.basis: Complete explicit ordered PDG basis -5..-1,1..5,21; massless nf5. Incoming fA/fB and h1 are unweighted, not x*f.
conventions.scales: Incoming fA/fB and h1 at mu^2=pT^2; outgoing D/Hhat3 evaluated and matched at mu_b^2=c0^2/bstar^2; evolve h1 and Hhat3 from Q0^2=2.4 with fixed nf5/Lambda=.225.
conventions.beam: Incoming h1 is collinear. No incoming TMD, SIDIS transversity matching coefficient, lepton DNN or incoming intrinsic gq is inserted.
conventions.single_quark_exponent: Spert_single_q=0.5*Spert_KPSY_pair; SNP_q=0.5*css_np_common+gh*b^2/z^2. For Collins use gh-gc instead of gh.
conventions.signed_limits: Preserve mu_b>Q signed Sudakov integration; no cap, no positivity clamp and no fitted-parameter/provider callback.
conventions.historical_ambiguity: The printed STAR17 dmu/mu formula followed by its half-leg prescription does not by itself fix the historical implementation. Canonical normalization is chosen explicitly using KPSY dmu^2/mu^2 and1705.08443 single-TMD equations. No claim of literal author-code recovery.
conventions.quark_matching: Cqq=delta+(alpha_s/pi)*CF*((1-v)/2+(1+v^2)*log(v)/(1-v)); Cgq=(alpha_s/pi)*CF*(v/2+(1+(1-v)^2)*log(v)/v). Delta coefficient at O(alpha_s) is zero in C11.
conventions.Collins_matching: Match and evolve canonical Hhat3, with regular coefficient2*CF*v*log(v)/(1-v) and zero C11 O(alpha_s) delta. Existing retained matched-row operators are extended to process STAR_C11 only for ff/collins. No full twist3 mixing is claimed.
conventions.Fourier: D=integral b db J0(jT*b/z)/(2*pi*z^2)*matched_D*exp(-S_q); C=jT/(z*Mh)*H1perp_Trento=-integral b^2 db J1(jT*b/z)/(4*pi*z^3)*matched_Hhat3*exp(-S_C). No additional -1/(2z) is applied after this transform.
conventions.moment_map: M= Mh*H1perp(1)=-Hhat3/(2*z). Evolving/matching M instead would require conjugating the convolution kernel by1/v; applying the unchanged Hhat3 kernel to M is invalid.
conventions.phase: Canonical sin(phiS-phiH); sin(phiH-phiS) flips the final amplitude once. Differential jT=0 gives zero UT and is not an integral sentinel.
conventions.hard_measure: Use STAR-BORN-001 absolute alpha_s^2/[S*xa*xb*(xa*S+U)] at every xa node. Supplied jet/bin/jT Jacobians and acceptance weights multiply UU and UT before division; never average point asymmetries.

fragmentation_choices.quark_only: Outgoing gluon TMD is zero; incoming gluons and collinear Dg-to-quark matching remain included. gluon_model must be none.
fragmentation_choices.quark_and_gluon: Requires explicit gluon_model=casimir_common_same_intrinsic_1705. Gluon Collins is zero; unpolarized gluon matching sums all nf5 quark and antiquark FFs once each.
fragmentation_choices.gluon_matching: Cgg=delta+(alpha_s/pi)*2*CA*(v*log(v)/(1-v)+(1-v)*log(v)/v+v*(1-v)*log(v)); Cqg=(alpha_s/pi)*TR*(v*(1-v)+(v^2+(1-v)^2)*log(v)). C11 delta constant zero. log(v)*plus-distribution has its ordinary finite endpoint limit.
fragmentation_choices.gluon_exponent: Single exponent=0.5*integral dln(mu^2)[Ag*ln(Q^2/mu^2)+Bg], Ag=CA/CF*Aq through alpha_s^2, Bg=-(11*CA/3-4*TR*nf/3)*alpha_s/(2*pi). SNP_g=CA/CF*0.5*css_np_common+gh*b^2/z^2. Same intrinsic gh is an explicit phenomenological assumption from1705 Eq78, not extracted evidence.

preparation.parameter_family: Same thirteen physical KPSY parameters. Sea/heavy h1 and heavy/gluon Collins remain zero at Q0 under the inherited family; no additional fitted gluon parameters.
preparation.fixed_work: Prepare native HOPPET rows, input samples, PDFs/FFs, hard/flavor contractions and Fourier weights before parameter evaluation. Julia performs generic initial functions, retained row products, damping and contractions during evaluation/AD.
preparation.bin_interface: Explicit supplied contexts/nonnegative measure weights and nonblank source. MomentumRule includes jT*djT; caller explicitly selects jT_djT or d2jT (adds2*pi). No acceptance or bin edges are inferred from horizontal errors.
preparation.integrity: Own copies of mutable supplied numerical arrays; snapshot all fixed cached scalars, arrays and provenance, and independently validate live retained operator/sample signatures. Mutation rejects rather than silently rebuilding.
preparation.jet_axis: Only standard axis. Positive jet radius is recorded; changing R alone does not implement finite-R matching. Scale prescription historical_pT_C11 must be explicit.
preparation.range: Provider reference extrapolation, if explicitly selected, is recorded and cannot admit data. Initial Q0 Soffer/FF samples always require strict inherited support.

validation_policy.derivative_fixture: Interior synthetic KPSY point, Nhd=-.91,beta_u=.4,beta_d=.7, other coordinates from rounded published parameters. Full13 gradient and directional HVP against256-bit fourth-order finite differences of a scalar reference assembly. Shared retained evolution/provider samples are not independent evolution evidence.
validation_policy.reference: Independent scalar full flavor assembly and recoil-rapidity measure; direct single-leg Sudakov and coefficient formulas, analytic Gaussian Fourier/moment controls, retained STAR/SIA delta-removal identity, explicit supplied-bin ratios. Refinements retain all coarse levels and compare declared final levels. No threshold tuning after failure.
validation_policy.scope: Reconstructed point/bin kernels and separately labeled analytic/synthetic controls. Not publication-matched acceptance, complete twist3 evolution, throughput, fitted data or calibrated coverage.

remaining_production_requirements: Historical author-code recovery or separately reviewed reconstruction and independent physical benchmark
Publication-matched STAR finite-R/axis/acceptance model and updated data covariance/overlap admission
Validated homogeneous Collins approximation and independent evolution/integration fixtures
Near-endpoint h1 interpolation error qualification across the intended physical workload; no inherited uniform pointwise query-aligned accuracy certificate
Frozen production gradient, performance and uncertainty coverage gates
Production numerical executor and real-data fit

beam_preparation.algorithm: One common single-log-grid HOPPET context spanning all declared beam queries. Evolve the zero-endpoint identity basis once at pT^2, use unchanged native interpolation to all xa queries, then detach flavor-independent query rows and close the native context before parameter evaluation.
beam_preparation.reason: The initial per-query log-grid construction encountered upstream TOO HIGH ACCURACY REQUIRED events; the pinned integrator returns zero on that error path. The initial run is retained as unqualified, not PASS.
beam_preparation.domain: Use the full declared physical xa nodes without endpoint cuts or clipping. Common grid starts at the smallest query; includes x=1 exactly and retains h1(1)=0.
beam_preparation.precision_guard: Capture native preparation stderr and reject TOO HIGH ACCURACY REQUIRED even if the C ABI returns status0. Validation producers retain the diagnostic log. No relaxation of eps, native solver order, physical thresholds or acceptance targets.
beam_preparation.carrier: HoppetPointPlan is the detached generic row carrier, tagged STAR_common_grid_batched_probes or STAR_common_grid_independent. This new geometry is certified by this contract, not by the old query-aligned point-plan checks.
beam_preparation.storage: Temporary beam preparation may hold O(Ngrid^2) basis/evolved arrays for one physical scale; detached rows use O(Nquery*Ngrid). This is not a physical fit-throughput certificate.
beam_preparation.checks: Require native-forward versus detached-row agreement at the inherited row tolerance; independent Mellin and full recoil/Fourier comparisons and final grid/outer refinements at unchanged STAR thresholds. Preserve original error logs and diagnostics.
beam_preparation.local_limit: The exploratory common-grid diagnostic at1024 intervals has about0.014 maximum scaled local h1 error near x=.999 under the old component relative-floor criterion. It is retained without a PASS label. This contract tests xa-integrated STAR observables against independent Mellin/recoil integrals, not uniform near-endpoint component accuracy. No endpoint cut or clipping is inserted.
